title: Mar Yochani
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Moed Katan 24a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.24a.1), Hyman reports that according to the Rif and Dikdukei Soferim Mar Yochani asked Shmuel. Hyman’s own text reads Rabbi Yochanan. In [Avodah Zarah 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.16b.8), Abaye said, “Mar Yehudah told me that in Mar Yochani’s household they turned the mills with wild asses.”[^1]

notes.text: The photographed notice ([Hyman II, p. 653](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/60/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf#page=236)) reads דק״ס. In [Dikdukei Soferim II, Moed Katan 24a, p. 78](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/XJfif6up1H4C?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=RA10-PA78), Rabbinovicz reports Mar Yochani from a Rif manuscript and the Venice and Constantinople editions. The consulted [Vilna Rif](https://www.sefaria.org/Rif_Moed_Katan.11b.4) and Davidson Gemara read Rabbi Yochanan. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1805&lang=en) names Mar Yochani as Shmuel’s questioner and gives the Avodah Zarah notice.
